compose:
services:
  files:
    image: ghcr.io/x/files:2
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: uploads
        target: /srv/uploads
        read_only: false
        volume:
          nocopy: true
volumes:
  uploads:
    labels:
      backup: daily
      owner: files
